management_notes: Management is operationally active and has executed a consistent drill program across 2025 and 2026 at Black Raven. The TSXV-approved Golden Baie option agreement (March 2026, 1,597 claims across a ~400 sq km, 30 km trend) demonstrates strategic land acquisition capability in a focused antimony corridor. Public disclosure on insider ownership percentages and management share alignment is limited in available sources; no insider buying events were identified in recent filings. Functional operational execution warrants a mid-range score without evidence of exceptional insider alignment or a track record of discovery-to-development transition.
geology_notes: Black Raven Project, Central Newfoundland, has returned high-grade antimony intercepts along approximately 800m of demonstrated strike: 19.23% Sb over 1.40m at Frost Cove North and 7.25% Sb over 1.98m near the Southern Shaft (August 28, 2026 assay results). The Spring 2026 program also discovered a new polymetallic system at PC Pond (0.78% Cu with 61.2 g/t Ag over 6.22m), expanding geological complexity and optionality. Black Raven sits 100km north of the historic Beaver Brook Antimony Mine — North America's largest primary antimony producer when operating — providing strong geological analog support. No NI 43-101 resource estimate has been published; the project remains in early-stage discovery. High grades are compelling, intercepts are narrow, and the mineralised system is still being delineated. Sector peer Southern Cross Gold (TSX: SXGC) continues to advance its gold-antimony Sunday Creek project in Australia with 9th-all-time intercepts at depth, confirming global investor appetite for high-grade antimony systems.
capital_notes: Shares issued stand at 316,681,940 — a heavy count for a pre-resource explorer that has yet to publish a NI 43-101 estimate. Fully diluted at 342,756,940 includes 2,625,000 warrants and 23,450,000 stock options (approximately 8.2% combined overhang); strike prices and expiry dates were not extracted from the April 2026 MD&A. No flow-through tranches were detected in the extracted filing data. The capital structure reflects accumulated exploration spending over multiple years of pre-resource work. Any future resource-estimate-driven financing would likely be dilutive at current implied market valuations. The large share base compresses per-share metrics and limits re-rating upside without a resource anchor.
catalyst_notes: Spring 2026 drilling and trenching assay results (August 28, 2026) represent the most recently completed catalyst — high-grade antimony at Frost Cove North and a new copper-silver polymetallic discovery at PC Pond. Near-term catalysts include: (1) additional 2026 drill results as delineation of Frost Cove North and PC Pond continues; (2) first-pass exploration on the newly optioned Golden Baie antimony-gold property; (3) macro: China antimony export controls (imposed 2024) continue to drive North American supply urgency and may intensify given ongoing US-China trade tensions. A maiden NI 43-101 resource estimate would be a transformative re-rating event but is likely 12–18+ months away given the current program stage. Gold at $4,420/oz (September 5, 2026) provides broader junior miner sentiment support, though a potential September 15–16 Fed rate hike (NFP blowout raised hike odds to ~60%) creates near-term macro headwind for speculative mining equities.
acquisition_notes: No NI 43-101 resource estimate exists, making P/NAV impossible to calculate. The antimony critical-mineral designation and China export controls add a strategic premium above standard junior valuation multiples for North American jurisdiction assets. Without a resource, any M&A transaction would be highly speculative and would likely require a resource estimate as a prerequisite for serious acquirer due diligence. The heavy share count also limits per-share transaction premiums. Comparable antimony-focused acquisitions in North America remain rare, leaving transaction multiples difficult to benchmark. Any strategic buyer would be acquiring optionality on high-grade drill results, not a defined resource.
analyst_summary: Churchill Resources is a pre-resource antimony explorer in Central Newfoundland with a compelling critical-mineral thesis: China controls over 80% of global primary antimony production and imposed export controls in 2024, creating structural urgency for North American supply development. The Black Raven Project has returned genuinely high-grade intersections — 19.23% Sb over 1.40m at Frost Cove North — along at least 800m of demonstrated strike, and the Spring 2026 program added a new copper-silver polymetallic discovery at PC Pond. The TSXV-approved Golden Baie option (March 2026) extends the antimony-gold land package across a 30km trend in the same region. No new material company-specific developments have been announced since the August 28, 2026 assay results. The bear case is straightforward: no NI 43-101 resource exists, the share count (316.7M issued, 342.8M fully diluted) is heavy for the stage, and the investment thesis rests almost entirely on discovery upside and the macro antimony supply deficit. WATCH is appropriate until a maiden resource estimate provides a NAV anchor. Retail investors should size to pre-resource risk.
